editorial:
Imagine waking up in a world where everything has fallen apart and you have to fight just to find a roof over your head. You follow a rough group of survivors who find a massive, decaying building and decide to make it their own. They aren't exactly the good guys, as they kill anyone who tries to stop them from taking over. But once they get settled in, they realize they aren't alone. There is a creepy girl in white wandering the halls and a dark, demonic energy that makes you feel like something terrible is about to happen. It feels like a mix of a post-apocalyptic wasteland and a ghost story, which keeps you guessing about what is actually real.

The movie has some really strange imagery and a slow burn that builds up a lot of tension. While the pacing can feel a bit sluggish in the middle, the weird atmosphere makes up for it. The acting is gritty and fits the bleak mood perfectly. If you love movies that feel like a fever dream, you should definitely check this out. It is a great pick for a rainy night when you want something truly odd.
endingExplained: As the story wraps up, you find out that the girl in white is actually a guardian for the demon god. The survivors realize that the building was never a safe haven, but a trap to feed the entity. In the end, the survivors are picked off one by one as the curse takes over. The final scenes show that no matter how hard they fought to own the place, the building actually owns them now.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves strange indie horror and post-apocalyptic settings.
